title: Dead outlet — no power at all
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Outlet delivers no power to a lamp you know works; The breaker does not look tripped. First step: Confirm the outlet is really dead with a known-good lamp

title: Breaker keeps tripping
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Breaker flips to the middle or OFF position repeatedly; Power dies on several outlets or lights at once. First step: Unplug everything on that circuit and reset the breaker

title: Flickering lights
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: One or more lights flicker or dim intermittently; Flicker happens when a large appliance starts. First step: Tighten the bulb — a loose bulb is the most common cause

title: GFCI outlet won't reset
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: RESET button will not stay in when pressed; Outlet is dead though the breaker is on. First step: Unplug everything from the GFCI and its downstream outlets

title: Doorbell stopped working
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: No chime when the button is pressed; Button feels loose or stuck. First step: Press the button firmly and listen at the chime for any hum

title: Ceiling fan wobbles
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Fan wobbles visibly at medium or high speed; Clicking or rattling noise while running. First step: Turn the fan off and check every blade screw for tightness

title: Smoke detector chirping
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Short chirp every 30–60 seconds; Chirp continues after pressing the hush button. First step: Replace the battery first — low battery is the top cause

title: Outlet sparks when plugging in
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Visible spark when a plug is inserted or removed; Scorch marks around the slots. First step: Note whether sparks are tiny and occasional or large and frequent

title: Dimmer switch buzzing
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Audible buzz from the dimmer switch; Buzz changes with dimmer level. First step: Confirm the bulbs are rated dimmable and match the dimmer's type

title: Light switch does nothing
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Flip the switch and the light stays off; Switch feels loose or crackles. First step: Test the bulb in a working lamp first

title: Bathroom exhaust fan noisy
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Loud rattling, humming, or squealing; Fan runs but moves little air. First step: Turn power off and vacuum dust from the grille and blades

title: Landscape lights out
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: All or some yard lights are dark; Transformer hums but lights stay off. First step: Check the transformer is plugged in and its timer settings

title: Outlet cover cracked
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Cover plate is cracked or broken; Plugs still work fine. First step: Confirm only the cover is damaged, not the outlet itself

title: Light fixture humming
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Steady hum or buzz from a ceiling fixture; Hum changes when dimmed. First step: Tighten the bulbs and any loose trim or glass

title: Extension cord feels hot
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Cord is warm or hot to the touch; Plastic smells hot or looks melted. First step: Unplug it immediately and let it cool

title: Three-way switch wired wrong
text: Field: Electrical. Symptoms: Two switches control one light but behave oddly; Light only works when one switch is in a certain position. First step: Flip both switches through all four combinations and note the pattern

title: Fridge not cooling
text: Field: Appliances. Symptoms: Fridge section feels warm though the light is on; Freezer still cold but fridge warming. First step: Check the thermostat setting and that vents inside are not blocked by food

title: Washer won't spin
text: Field: Appliances. Symptoms: Washer fills and agitates but never spins; Clothes come out soaking wet. First step: Open and close the lid firmly — a bad lid switch or lock stops the spin

title: Dryer no heat
text: Field: Appliances. Symptoms: Dryer tumbles but clothes stay cold and damp; Takes multiple cycles to dry. First step: Confirm it is really no-heat, not just slow drying

title: Dishwasher not cleaning dishes
text: Field: Appliances. Symptoms: Dishes come out spotty or gritty; Film or residue on glasses. First step: Pull out and rinse the filter at the tub bottom — a clogged filter is the top cause
